$comment: Auditable exceptions for pnpm secret:scan. A suppression is bound to one exact match: path + ruleId + sha256 fingerprint of the normalized matched value. Changing a single character of that value invalidates the entry and the finding reappears. Wildcards, whole-file and whole-directory entries are rejected by the loader, and every suppressed finding is still printed on each run. A fingerprint is a one-way digest, never the value.
